content:
elaine: sharing a compact-row mock for the latency list — p95 + small inline sampler. can ppl skim before tomorrows review? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/latency-compact-sampler

marta: nice direction. three quick things: 1) sampler pill contrast is low against the row bg 2) does it get keyboard focus? 3) how does screen reader announce the current sample rate?

sam: implementation heads-up — inline resizable controls will force row height changes and can cause list reflow / virtualization churn. prefer a stable row height with a popover trigger that opens the sampler.

elaine: good call. my rationale for inline was to expose the control for power users (fast toggles across many services). we could keep inline for one-line compact but anchor a popover for fine-grain settings.

kevin: copy nit: "Sampler" is vague for some PMs. maybe "sampling rate" or "trace sample". tooltip could be "Limits number of traces shown to reduce query cost". also change CTA from "Apply" to "Update view" — clearer.

marta: accessibility suggestion for the inline pill: role="button" is not enough. it should be either a focusable range control or an ARIA combobox with options: 1%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 100%. We should announce as: "Sampling rate, 10 percent, press enter to change."

sam: example aria snippet I can wire if we go popover: ```html
<button aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-expanded="false" aria-label="Sampling rate, 10 percent">10%</button>
```

sam: if inline slider: ```html
<input type="range" min="1" max="100" step="1" aria-label="Sampling rate" value="10">
```

elaine: thanks, Sam — that helps. what about keyboard shortcuts? e.g., when a row is focused, pressing "+" increments sampling and "-" decrements. worth discussing?

kevin: love shortcut idea but we need discoverability. maybe tooltip with "press +/- to adjust sample" and a keyboard help modal. also ensure shortcuts don't conflict with browser or editor.

marta: a11y extra: color alone shouldn't be used to indicate active sampling. add an icon or outline. and ensure 3:1 contrast for the pill at small sizes.

elaine: i'll update the mock with 3 variants: inline compact (read-only summary + popover), inline editable (keyboard + slider), and popover-only. will add copy options too.

kevin: thanks. quick ask for the review tomorrow: can you include perf notes about expected reflow cost per 1k rows if we keep inline? Sam can add numbers.

design-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled <2033332400> (tomorrow 10:00am PT). Agenda: compact list sampler + keyboard patterns.

sam: i'll run a quick perf microbenchmark and paste numbers in the thread before review.

elaine: perfect, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
